bio: Perched high above Central Park, YŪGIN is the first restaurant from Chef Eugeniu Zubco. The intimate 12-seat counter blends traditional omakase with influences drawn from the chef’s travels and professional experiences. The experience begins with a series of composed seasonal dishes that showcase Zubco's broader culinary perspective before transitioning into a classical nigiri progression. Throughout the meal, pristine seafood, carefully sourced ingredients and restrained seasoning take center stage, while subtle European influences occasionally emerge alongside traditional Japanese techniques. Custom ceramics and sweeping views over Manhattan complete the highly polished experience.
